Messages.Author: Paul Steiner
Messages.Body:
When playing a gather if you have 2 copies of a specific Gangrel in your
uncontrolled region do you choose a specific one to be named or can you
choose which one to bring out when you tap the Gather to bring the
vampire into play.
Thanks,
Paul

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The uncontrolled vampire is chosen by card, not by name.
